messages:
ops-june: Heads-up team: sterile change window starts in 25m for release v2.7.2. Start 2026-03-21 21:00 UTC. Please ack and stop non-emergency merges.

liam-eng: Ack. I'll handle traffic pinning and rollout commands.

karen-qa: Ack. QA running final regression suite; will post failures here if any.

ops-june: Rules: pin model and service, freeze infra changes, no schema changes. If you need to break the freeze, add `freeze-exception` tag and @ops-june + #war-room notify. Rollback owner = @sre-lina.

deploy-bot: Reminder: smoke test flag enabled by default. Use `/deploy release=v2.7.2 region=eu-west canary=3% smoke=true`.

liam-eng: Will run at T-10. command: `/deploy release=v2.7.2 region=eu-west canary=3% smoke=true`

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by liam-eng. Pinning route... pinned to v2.7.2 (pin-id=pin-6120).

deploy-bot: Smoke checks: auth flows OK, embeddings service responds, CPU within target. SMOKE: PASS.

karen-qa: Quick note: found a tiny rounding diff in billing sample outputs (6/1000). Filing as non-blocker but QA flagged for post-rollout monitoring.

sre-lina: Noted. Setting alert for billing-regression at low severity.

liam-eng: Canary up to 3% at 21:03 UTC. Watching p95/p99 and error budget.

ops-june: Canary watchers: @sre-lina (alerts), @liam-eng (deploy traces), @karen-qa (user journeys). If we see sustained error-rate >0.2% or p99 spike >+60ms, rollback.

sre-lina: Seeing 5 502s from alexa-edge-2 in the last 10m. Investigating whether it's an upstream edge flake.

liam-eng: I hit the edge-2 logs, looks like connection reset during TLS handshake. Not widespread.

deploy-bot: Observability summary: 502s concentrated on alexa-edge-2 (5/8k requests), overall error-rate 0.07%.

ops-june: OK hold for 10m. If it persists, we'll traffic-shift off edge-2 manually before rollback. Rollback still last resort.

karen-qa: No functional regressions in the flows I ran. Rounding diff is only visible in synthetic, not production samples.

liam-eng: Canary steady, ramping to 20% now: `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.2 region=eu-west split=20`

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.2 -> 20% in eu-west.

sre-lina: Edge-2 502s dropped after connection pool recycle. All stacks green.

ops-june: Proceed to 50% in 15m if no regressions. Reminder: changelog locked. Any post-deploy fixes must follow emergency hotfix flow: create branch prefixed `hotfix/` -> tag freeze-exception -> contact ops -> run hotfix smoke in staging then run small canary.

liam-eng: Understood. I'll prepare hotfix template in case.

karen-qa: QA ready for hotfix smoke if needed.

liam-eng: Rolling to 50% now. `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.2 split=50 region=eu-west`

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.2 -> 50% in eu-west.

ops-june: Good. Keep the watch for billing rounding regression; if it creeps beyond threshold flag it as P1.

product-ryan: Product confirms the minor rounding diff is acceptable for this patch; prefer to monitor.

liam-eng: Rolling to 100% in 10m if all clear.

sre-lina: No alerts firing. Latency within SLOs.

karen-qa: All QA suites nominal.

ops-june: All clear to proceed to full rollout. Liam please do a controlled ramp to 100% and then lock the freeze for 60m post-rollout.

liam-eng: `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.2 split=100 region=eu-west` -> executing now.

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.2 -> 100% in eu-west. Full rollout complete.

ops-june: Freeze locked. Post-launch monitoring window: 60m. Keep alerts on and dedicated watchers.

product-ryan: I'll prepare the customer-facing blurb after monitoring.

liam-eng: Noted. Quick post-check: no increase in user errors, traces look normal.

karen-qa: Scheduling a targeted regression run on the billing prompts to capture more samples.

sre-lina: If we need to perform an emergency unpin: steps = 1) add freeze-exception 2) notify ops 3) run `/deploy rollback target=v2.6.10 reason="emergency_unpin"` 4) validate smoke.

ops-june: Good procedure. Close the loop by updating the change log after the sterile window ends. Thanks team. :tada:

deploy-bot: Summary: release=v2.7.2 region=eu-west duration=35m smoke=PASS canary=3%->100% rollback=standby

ops-june: End of thread  sterile window active until 22:05 UTC."
